utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Monday the twentieth. Can you hear me all right? Teams is doing that thing with the microphone again.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, you're on. Unlike the traffic on the ring road, which wasn't moving at all. Spent half my morning looking at the same van.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Lovely view, was it?

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Better than the football last night. Honestly, ninety minutes I'm not getting back.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: You say that every Monday, mate.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Right, before we do the list—anything already finished that we can get out of the way?

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, I signed off the inspection on the fire alarm panel on Tuesday. That's done, not something I'm picking up again today.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: That was the panel inspection, not the monthly fire alarm test, yeah?

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Exactly. Panel inspection signed off. Separate thing.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Well, I'll run the monthly fire alarm test on the 3rd. It matters but it's not urgent.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Cheers, Cal. Monthly fire alarm test on the 3rd, agreed.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah. Keeping that separate from the inspection that's already done.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: And I tested the site water yesterday and it's all fine now. That's finished too; no repeat test being added here.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yeah so, I'll go to Tollgate to pick up the replacement parts for the water system by end of day.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Thanks, Priya. Tollgate collection for the water system, by end of day.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yep, collection only. I'm not promising an installation as part of that.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Um, just an observation from me. Saw the pressure on the relief valve dip for a few minutes, then it came back on its own.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Without anyone touching anything?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah, recovered by itself. Just passing on what I saw, not raising another job.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Understood. Observation only.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: And I still can't get to the line 1 mould temp until production gives us a window. That's blocked, not a commitment for today.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, there's no window agreed. That's where it stands.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Right, so that one stays blocked.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Sarah, can you swap the filter on the IM1 hydraulic unit today at 2pm?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll swap the filter on the IM1 hydraulic unit today at 2pm.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Sorry, talked over the end there. Just the filter, we're not talking about a full unit job?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Just the filter, yeah. No extra scope.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Good, that's agreed.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And I'll do a site visit at Northfield with the contractor after lunch. Low priority, that one.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Okay, Saz. Northfield with the contractor after lunch, low priority. Does that fit with the filter at 2pm?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah, I can fit both. The filter stays at 2pm; I'm accepting both as we've said them.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: The Northfield bit is just a visit, then? Not a whole load of contractor work tucked underneath it?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Just the site visit with the contractor. Nothing else being signed up to here.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Right. I'll inspect the Boiler Feedwater Pump for leaks by end of day. It's urgent.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Thanks, Tom. Urgent leak inspection on the Boiler Feedwater Pump, then.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yeah, mine. By end of day.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Inspection rather than committing to a repair before we know what we're looking at?

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Exactly. Inspect for leaks. Not inventing a repair job on the call.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: David Whitfield, can you do the lock-out tag-out sign-off on the Line 3 Chiller next Tuesday? Drop everything for that one.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: No, sorry, I can't take that. I'm not available for it next Tuesday, so don't put it against me.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Okay. Cal, can you take the lock-out tag-out sign-off on the Line 3 Chiller instead, next Tuesday? Drop everything for that one.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll take it instead. Lock-out tag-out sign-off on the Line 3 Chiller next Tuesday. Drop everything for that one, understood.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: That's the one at the top of the pile, then? Just so the other isolation work doesn't get muddled into it.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yes, the Line 3 Chiller sign-off is the drop-everything one. Still next Tuesday.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: And separately, I'll sort the permit to work and isolation for the line 1 hydraulics next Tuesday. It matters but it's not urgent.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Thanks, Callum. Permit to work and isolation for the line 1 hydraulics, next Tuesday. Important, but not urgent.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: That's right. Two separate bits, not one big isolation sign-off.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: I'll send the shift handover report round by the 28th. No rush on that.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Okay, Olumide. Shift handover report by the 28th, no rush.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll take that. Not saying it's going round this morning.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: And just checking my panel inspection hasn't ended up back on the list while we were talking dates. That's the finished one.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: No, still finished. Cal's monthly test is separate; no second panel inspection.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Last one from me: I'll grease and check the bearings on the Gas Turbine 1. That's a whenever you get a chance one.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: All right, Tom. Gas Turbine 1 bearings, whenever you get a chance.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yep, I'll take it, but there's no fixed deadline on that one.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Your list's got everything from drop everything to whenever you fancy it.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Whenever you get a chance, not whenever I fancy it. Small but expensive distinction.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Put that on a mug. Better than the ones we've got.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Can we just keep the line 1 mould temp blocker separate from the line 1 hydraulics permit? Similar names, different things.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah, absolutely. The mould temp is still blocked by the production window. Nothing about that changed in this call.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Agreed. No window magically appeared while I was talking.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Shame. Could do with a bit of magic on the ring road as well.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Right, that's us. Finished work stays finished, blocked work stays blocked, and the agreed bits are clear. Thanks, everyone.
